title: Nano PDF Editor — Edit PDF files with Nano Banana

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Nano PDF Editor command line tool that lets you edit PDF slides using nothing but natural language powered by Nano Banana Pro. Imagine saying update the graph to include data from 2025 and it just does it or turn this chart into a bar graph done instantly. Nano PDF editor doesn't just generate new visuals.
